features.evidence: Phase1 and isolated external/tarball package fixtures
features.reason_or_fallback: Runtime and editor assemblies use Built-in Unity APIs; no URP, SRP Core or RenderGraph dependency.

features.evidence: Phase1 discovery and standalone shader-retention checks
features.reason_or_fallback: All six original names are preserved, including Hidden/Nova/Particles/ApplyDistortion.

features.evidence: All 889 original ShaderLab declarations compared, including attributes, ranges, order and defaults
features.reason_or_fallback: Original public names and defaults remain, including obsolete compatibility properties.

features.evidence: 525 public/protected declarations, 14 original Inspector/helper source contracts, real OnGUI, multi-edit and Undo/Redo tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Original class names, labels, CustomEditor declarations, foldout icons and saved preferences remain. Batch GUI tests cover Layout/Repaint and property edits; native mouse input has not been automated.

features.evidence: 735 differential state transitions against original processors, raw/validated snapshots and shader reassignment
features.reason_or_fallback: Render state, keyword setup and particle streams remain. Uber raw materials retain queue 2000. Distortion defaults to queue 3100 so shader-only background capture occurs after transparents; an explicit material queue still wins. Original URP could keep queue 2000 because its renderer feature drew the effect separately.

features.evidence: Six direct original-GUID imports, six legacy aliases, optional normalizer, unchanged Fire001 assets
features.reason_or_fallback: Original standard shader references need no conversion, including embedded/binary references. Effect Import omits bundled NOVA source; ordinary all-selected Unity import can conflict. Old Built-in aliases remain usable; custom/optimized shader GUIDs require a port or regeneration. See Migration.md.

features.evidence: Showcase tests plus generated scene image
features.reason_or_fallback: Package Manager imports a playable scene with four particle variants and moving distortion; the generator preserves the active saved scene and refuses overwrites.

features.evidence: MaterialSetup, minimum rendering, Lit multiply-albedo-before-lighting regression, interaction and imported MIT sample comparisons
features.reason_or_fallback: Material blend/cull/queue/depth controls match. Equal-depth transparent renderers with tied sort keys can composite differently across pipelines (heal02 sample). Set distinct renderer sortingOrder values when deterministic overlap is required; this is an explicit authoring fallback, not automatic asset conversion.

features.evidence: Shared color and actual ParticleSystem tests
features.reason_or_fallback: RGB and alpha streams affect all four Uber shaders.

features.evidence: Shared color, particle Custom1/Custom2 and interaction tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Vertex alpha can drive transition progress while retaining the original alpha interpretation.

features.evidence: Color, DepthOnly, ShadowCaster and selection rendering tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Cutoff and alpha-modulate behavior are preserved in applicable passes.

features.evidence: 2D/array/3D color and original-image comparisons
features.reason_or_fallback: Slice/progress selection is implemented for all four shaders on capable hardware; see Platform scope.

features.evidence: Coordinate, deformation and ParticleSystem tests; 24 original-order Base UV graphics cases and four Lit alpha-pass texture-transform cases
features.reason_or_fallback: Base rotations/pivots precede tiling/offset, followed by custom offsets. Array/volume transforms reach Lit depth/shadow passes. Original property mappings and UI-specific stream layout are retained.

features.evidence: Base/tint/transition/emission row tests, interaction suite, eight Lit alpha-pass cases and out-of-range Custom Data GPU probes
features.reason_or_fallback: Original row count and custom/random coordinate selection remain, including parallax and second transition. Base progress is computed in the vertex stage as in original NOVA. Combined progress is normalized by the selected row before clamping, including values outside 0..1.

features.evidence: Original-image comparison and 36 Lit surface-sampler cases
features.reason_or_fallback: D3D11/12 uses matching point/linear/trilinear mirror samplers. Coupled-sampler backends use mirrored UVs and texture-import filtering; configure matching filters on those platforms.

features.evidence: Shared base/channel tests and visual capture
features.reason_or_fallback: Original color channel selection and texture-channel controls remain.

features.evidence: Shared tone tests and original-image comparison
features.reason_or_fallback: Tone thresholds, colors and custom coordinates retain the original math.

features.evidence: Shared 2D/array/3D tint, row and interaction tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Constant/map tint, blend controls and obsolete 3D aliases are retained.

features.evidence: Shared rim/tint rendering tests
features.reason_or_fallback: World normal/view normalization and interpolation match the original in the 2022 D3D coarse-mesh capture. No independent rim mismatch was reproduced; other backends remain unverified.

features.evidence: Shared Base/Tint/Emission/AlphaTransition tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Signed XY offsets, channel selection, rotation and target flags are implemented. Lit surface maps keep their original pre-flow UVs.

features.evidence: 36 mode/target cases, signed back-facing GPU probes and randomized reference captures
features.reason_or_fallback: Base/Tint/Emission support 2D/array/3D height maps with the original one-step offset. The signed offset denominator matches original NOVA except for a +/-1e-4 singularity guard. The tangent-space view is now formed per vertex and interpolated, including original odd-scale handling. Avoid only the guarded near-zero denominator; see LowCostLightingParity.md.

features.evidence: Shared color-correction tests and visual capture
features.reason_or_fallback: Original luminance and gradient lookup operations remain.

features.evidence: Shared fade/dissolve, texture-mode and flow tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Fade/dissolve thresholds, sharpness, texture modes and progress controls are implemented.

features.evidence: Interaction tests for array/3D, random rows, average/multiply
features.reason_or_fallback: Both transition maps combine using the original blend controls and alpha semantics.

features.evidence: Shared area/map/color/intensity/edge tests and visual capture
features.reason_or_fallback: All/alpha/map areas, explicit/base/ramp colors, 2D/array/3D maps and edge transparency remain. As in original Lit, the common stack supplies lit albedo.

features.evidence: Shared transparency and interaction tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Luminance math is preserved; the rim normal/view conditions also match the original in the coarse-mesh captures. The retained progress/sharpness/inverse controls remain unchanged.

features.evidence: Camera-depth, stereo and URP-version sampler GPU tests; randomized visible-depth witness
features.reason_or_fallback: Unity 6 matches URP 17 PointClamp; Unity 2022 retains URP 14 texture sampling. Requires a Built-in camera depth texture containing opaque casters. Enable DepthTextureMode.Depth; transparent depth writes do not provide the same URP input.

features.evidence: Camera distance/range and combined-feature tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Uses explicit eye depth and the original near/far/width controls. Camera projection differs by pipeline; tune the same eye-space distances after migration.

features.evidence: Forward/depth/shadow/selection and custom-coordinate tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Texture-driven position deformation and stream-driven offsets are carried into applicable passes.

features.evidence: Actual ParticleSystem vertex-color/custom-stream rendering
features.reason_or_fallback: Configure the original NOVA vertex streams using the Inspector.

features.evidence: Actual instanced mesh ParticleSystem rendering for all five visible shaders
features.reason_or_fallback: Unity's Built-in particle instancing buffer provides transforms, colors and custom data; procedural instancing variants are compiled in applicable passes.

features.evidence: Four stereo shadowed ForwardAdd compiler regressions and fifteen GPU texture-array tests: four Uber color passes, per-eye soft-particle depth, particle DepthOnly/DepthNormals/ShadowCaster, and distortion eye textures
features.reason_or_fallback: Built-in stereo macros carry the vertex eye index to fragments and depth slices. Tested with explicit XR constant buffers on D3D11/12 without a headset; actual VRChat PCVR/headset verification remains separate.

features.evidence: 24 perspective/orthographic Linear/Exp/Exp2 cases and ForwardAdd diagnostics
features.reason_or_fallback: Uses the original vertex clip-Z fog coefficient and interpolation, including EXP scaling. ForwardAdd fades toward black. The original orthographic/oblique clip-depth behavior is retained, even when it produces no fog; pipeline camera/fog inputs and other backends still require matching.

features.evidence: Analytic GPU tests and 72 original/port PBR frame comparisons
features.reason_or_fallback: Original GGX direct BRDF, diffuse energy, F0 and roughness math are preserved without URP includes. Light selection/attenuation and ambient data still come from Built-in; match scene light/probe settings after migration.

features.evidence: Imported DXT5 packing, normal scale and 2D/array/3D tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Unity normal packing is decoded before XY scale, as in the original. The normal is normalized after interpolation before the tangent-space transform; interpolated tangent/binormal are not independently normalized, matching original fragUnlit/fragLit ordering. Original normal-map and parallax handedness differ and are preserved separately. Supply valid tangents; see LowCostLightingParity.md.

features.evidence: Metallic/specular/smoothness channel and texture-mode tests, original PBR captures
features.reason_or_fallback: Sampling, channel selection, shared base filtering and original BRDF response are retained. Final lighting uses Built-in light/probe inputs; match those scene inputs when migrating.

features.evidence: Direction/color/intensity, normal-map rendering and automatic initial lighting and Undo tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Built-in ForwardBase supplies the main directional light. URP light selection differs. Configure a directional key light and initial setup now preserves original intensity values automatically; Match Original Lighting Settings can reapply them; see Migration.md.

features.evidence: Shared point/spot/range/direction tests for both Lit shaders
features.reason_or_fallback: ForwardAdd uses Built-in attenuation and shadows, with alpha and UI clipping preserved. Set per-pixel lights/Quality pixel-light count appropriately; it is not a Forward+ light loop.

features.evidence: Lit/UI directional receiver, toggles and combined-feature tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Built-in attenuation affects direct light, leaving ambient/reflections separate. Bias, cascades and filtering follow Built-in Light/Quality settings; retune them after migration.

features.evidence: 1,008 nonblack-ambient/original image comparisons plus 12 focused GPU tests and eight spatial LPPV cases
features.reason_or_fallback: SH/proxy irradiance no longer has a scene-color floor. Reflection-map-off glossy DC, scene reflection intensity, sRGB low-light and HDR conversion match the tested original inputs; the previous 22/192 failures are resolved. The scriptless fallback recovers renderer SH DC, while URP supplies global ambient-probe DC separately. Local/custom probes can therefore differ from the global fallback; match probe inputs or enable reflection maps. See AmbientLighting.md and the repository AmbientLightingParity.md report.

features.evidence: Both Lit shaders: analytic roughness response and original captures with mip-colored cubemaps/view angles
features.reason_or_fallback: Original perceptual-roughness mip selection, surface reduction and grazing Fresnel are preserved. Disabling reflection maps retains glossy ambient as in original NOVA (0.1.6). Probe assignment/capture uses Built-in. Original NOVA also omits probe-blending/box-projection shader variants; use one suitable probe or a custom/default cubemap.

features.evidence: Original ParticlesUberLitForward.hlsl input/GI initialization
features.reason_or_fallback: Original NOVA uses SH (or Unity 6 APV), has no lightmap UV path and sets vertexLighting to zero. The port does not add those absent paths.

features.evidence: Particle Uber and Distortion editor-pass rendering
features.reason_or_fallback: Original pass names and selection IDs remain. Alpha/deformation are rendered, but Unity's editor invocation differs by pipeline; use normal Built-in selection tooling.

features.evidence: Caster alpha/deformation, receive-shadow and compile tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Uses Built-in ShadowCaster bias/variants. Enable the original caster controls and renderer shadow casting; retune light bias. UI shaders originally had no caster pass.

features.evidence: Explicit depth-pass rendering and optimizer tests
features.reason_or_fallback: The pass can be drawn explicitly, but Built-in camera depth normally comes from ShadowCaster. Retain that pass and enable camera depth for depth effects.

features.evidence: 128 original/port image pairs, seven camera/pass tests, two stereo array cases and optimizer outputs
features.reason_or_fallback: Particle shaders provide encoded world normals plus coverage through an explicit pass and optional NovaDepthNormals camera buffer. It does not replace world depth normals or implement the URP prepass invocation/format. Use the dedicated Texture API; see DepthNormals.md.

features.evidence: Existing multi-light/shadow ForwardAdd suites and Canvas selection/rendering tests
features.reason_or_fallback: Mesh/particle renderers retain ForwardBase/ForwardAdd; optional Canvas lighting evaluates up to eight selected lights in one pass. There is no tiled/clustered renderer. Control pixel lights and the Canvas limit; Canvas list shadows/cookies are not sampled.

features.evidence: Eight spatial LPPV GPU tests on both Lit shaders, local/world coordinates and fallback
features.reason_or_fallback: Native Built-in LPPV replaces ordinary SH L0/L1 while retaining renderer L2, without double addition. APV file formats, streaming, adaptive placement and scenario changes are not supported. Use world-supplied Built-in probes/LPPV; avatars cannot require a world to provide them.

features.evidence: URP 17.3 official include audit and D3D mono/stereo depth/screen-UV regressions
features.reason_or_fallback: URP non-uniform-raster coordinate remapping is disabled on the verified Windows D3D path, so its transforms are identity there. Existing per-eye UV/depth paths remain. This does not implement non-uniform remapping for Metal/PS5 or control XR runtime VRS; physical runtime/headset verification remains separate.

features.evidence: 32 GPU view assertions and two actual diagnostic-variant AssetBundle stripping tests

features.evidence: 19 camera-compositor and 19 shader-only visibility/control cases, per-eye texture sampling, and 14 original-name API graphics/lifetime cases
features.reason_or_fallback: The shader automatically uses a named GrabPass when no supported camera compositor is active. VRChat avatars need no custom component. The mono camera compositor and restored ApplyDistortionPass/DistortedUvBufferPass execute real Built-in commands. Five original constructor/setup/reset signatures are callable; URP inheritance and engine-specific parameters still require adaptation. See RuntimeAPICompatibility.md and BuiltInRenderingAPI.md.

features.evidence: Positive/negative/vertical/off-center tests; 256 randomized original/port cases across two editors, two color spaces and two anisotropy settings (all pass)
features.reason_or_fallback: The camera compositor accumulates signed offsets in RGHalf (ARGBHalf fallback). Forced anisotropy uses an explicit 8x sampler, the nearest supported inline value to original forced 9x. Other quality settings retain ordinary sampling. Raster/depth rounding and 8x/9x filtering can still differ; Disable is a tested explicit quality option when forced filtering is unwanted. No project quality setting or material is rewritten. The shader-only path captures background once per camera using a named GrabPass and distorts per surface; overlapping nonzero offsets are not accumulated across objects, and the extra scene copy has a GPU cost. Zero-offset surfaces discard, preserving distortion underneath without another screen copy (ordinary and reflected-camera regressions). Uniform-zero strength with unused Custom Data coordinates rejects geometry before rasterization; active-surface overhead and invisible-layer savings were measured on D3D11.
